name: dsh-mdvault
description: Workspace document vault for the dsh web GUI: a conversation '文档' tab with an all-type file tree (Markdown/PDF/HTML/code/Excel·CSV/images), full GFM rendering via the platform MarkdownText (tables, task lists, footnotes, KaTeX math, highlighted code fences), Mermaid diagrams, Obsidian-style [[wikilinks]], PDF blob preview, image zoom/pan, native SheetJS spreadsheets, and in-page editing with find/replace. Optional dsh-better-sidebar viewer integration.
